077025 SPC is listed as a special non-contributory benefit for the purposes of EC law 1. Such benefits are
only payable in, and at the expense of, the State in which the person is habitually resident. This means
that SPC is payable in the UK only and EC law does not permit export of this benefit to claimants living
abroad.

                                                                1 Reg (EC) No. 883/04, Art 70; and Annex X
